g.text: Supplier-zero control | Actual JLCPCB 3D top-side previews
U1 PCB angle = 0°. The chosen C916374 model needs +180° to match this authored footprint.
Two-lead side is opposite the PCB pads
Two-lead side and pin-1 dot match the pads
Apply this same +180° to every U row, on both sides, in both A/B files. Diode rows keep their 0° supplier offset.
A side-convention error can cancel a supplier-zero error: raw main U4 happens to align while raw U3 does not.
